_comment: The shape of NHC_tropical_weather_summary/MapServer/23 (Footprint_Inun), whose schema was read live on 2026-09-09; it returned zero features that day, because P-Surge issues an inundation product only for a storm under a surge watch or warning. Everything here is synthetic: the geometry is a rectangle off the Louisiana coast, and objectid is included for realism though the service omits it under the restricted outFields this code sends. category is a string here and an integer on the service; nothing reads it. The f=geojson envelope and the four property names are the service's own, and productname and name are the only fields the code reads.
